review.tagline: Neovim plugin that adds Cursor-style AI chat and code edits inside the editor
review.summary: avante.nvim is a Lua Neovim plugin with a Rust-built component. It opens a chat sidebar that answers questions about the current file and applies suggested changes to source files. It supports an agentic mode with tools, ACP agents such as codex and gemini, and many model providers. A per-project avante.md file supplies instructions.
review.audience: Neovim users who want Cursor-like AI editing without leaving the editor
strengths: Runs inside Neovim; suggested changes can be applied to files with one command
Supports many providers: openai, anthropic, mistral, deepseek, ollama, llama-cpp, copilot
ACP support lets external agents like codex and gemini drive edits
Project-level avante.md instructions file; optional local RAG service
weaknesses: Requires Neovim 0.11+ (badge says 0.12+); README is inconsistent on version
Install needs a build step: make with curl and tar, or cargo to build from source
Auto-suggestions are marked experimental and costly because of high request frequency
Tool permissions are auto-approved by default (auto_approve_tool_permissions = true)
needs: Needs Neovim 0.11+, plenary.nvim, nui.nvim, mega.cmdparse, curl and tar, or cargo, provider API key or local model server
Models: claude, openai, azure, gemini, cohere
